title: Sare shabbir rota hai
body:
SAR E ABBAS GIRTA HAI
SAR E SHABBIR ROTA HAI
SINA KI NOK SAY JISDUM SAR E ABBAS GIRTA HAI
JHUKAE SIR KO GHARAT KA KHUDA KATON PAY CHALTA
2) JISE TA UMR KHUD SARWER NE SHEHZADI PUKARA HAI
JANAB E FATEMA ZEHRA NE JISKA NAAM RAKKHA HAI
SHARABI BHEED MAY JUB OS KA KOI NAAM LETA HAI
SAR E SHABBIR ROTA HAI
SINA KI NOK SAY JISDUM SAR E ABBAS GIRTA HAI
3) KIA THA USSE WADA TERE GHAR MEHMAN AAUNGA
MAI SHEHZADO'N KO OR SHEHZADIYO'N KO SATH LAUNGA
SARE RAHE SITAM GHAR JISGHADI SHIRI'N KA DIKHTA HAI
SAR E SHABBIR ROTA HAI
SINA KI NOK SAY JISDUM SAR E ABBAS GIRTA HAI
4) TAMACHO KE SITAM SEHKAR SAKINA CHUP JO REHTI HAI
kABHI KAATO'N PAY CHALTI HAI KABHI PYASI TADAPTI HAI
SAKINA KO DIKHAKAR SHIMR JUB PANI GIRATA HAI
SAR E SHABBIR ROTA HAI
SINA KI NOK SAY JISDUM SAR E ABBAS GIRTA HAI
5) WAHI HAI SAMNE AKBAR KO JISNE BARCHI MARI THI
VO MANZAR YAAD ATA HAI KE JUB BARCHI NIKALI THI
ALI AKBAR KA QATIL JUB SINA KE SATH CHALTA HAI
SAR E SHABBIR ROTA HAI
SINA KI NOK SAY JISDUM SAR E ABBAS GIRTA HAI
6) JAWAN SHABBIR KA BETA LIYE JUB AALE PAYGHAMBAR
SAR E BAZAR AYA TOE ZAIFI CHAGAI OS PAR
SITAMGAR HALPAR BIMAAR AABID KE JO HASTA HAI
SAR E SHABBIR ROTA HAI
SAR E SHABBIR ROTA HAI
SINA KI NOK SAY JISDUM SAR E ABBAS GIRTA HAI
7) SAR E SHABBIR VO BAZAR MAY SALMAN OR AKBAR
LABO PAR THI TILAWAT OR AAKHEN THI LAHU SAY TAR
RIDAYE'N DEKHKAR NAIZE PAY BEHNO KI TADAPTA HAI
SAR E SHABBIR ROTA HAI
SAR E SHABBIR ROTA HAI
SINA KI NOK SAY JISDUM SAR E ABBAS GIRTA HAI
